quote: try { localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_KEY, raw); } catch (e) { /* storage is already failing; the load message says so */ }
title: Backup failure is swallowed while the load message tells the user the data was kept; the next save then destroys the original
evidence: backupRaw returns nothing, and the callers at store.js:47, 52 and 66 ignore the result. The messages at store.js:48, 53 and 67 state 'was kept under notes-backup' unconditionally. The comment claims the load message reports the failure, but those messages say the opposite. A backup is a second copy of a value that is already in storage, so it is the write most likely to hit the quota. Each backup also overwrites the previous one.
failing_case: Storage holds a corrupt or partly unreadable 3 MB 'notes' value in a ~5 MB quota. On load, setItem(BACKUP_KEY) throws QuotaExceededError and is swallowed. The page shows 'The unreadable data was kept under notes-backup'. The user presses New note: saveNotes replaces the 'notes' value, and the original data exists nowhere, though they were told it was kept. A second corruption event later also overwrites the first backup with no warning.
remediation: Make backupRaw return success or failure, and word the load message from that result ('could not be backed up either; do not edit, export it first'). Block or confirm the first save while an unbacked-up unreadable value exists, and do not overwrite an existing backup (timestamped key or refuse).

title: Every save overwrites the whole store from one tab's in-memory copy; a second tab silently deletes the first tab's notes
evidence: saveNotes serialises the module-level `notes` array of the calling tab (app.js:18, 33) and replaces the single key. No `storage` event listener exists in app.js, and notes are read from storage only once, at load (app.js:17). Traced; the browser was not driven because shell access was denied.
failing_case: Open the app in tab A and tab B (both load note X). In tab A press New note: storage now holds X and Y. In tab B edit X's title and wait 500 ms: flushSave calls saveNotes([X']) and storage holds only X'. Note Y is gone. Tab A still shows Y until it is reloaded, and then it is not there. Tab B reports 'Saved'.
remediation: Listen for the `storage` event on STORAGE_KEY and merge or reload before writing. Or re-read storage inside saveNotes and merge by id with `updated`, so a save never replaces records the tab has not seen.

title: Opening or deleting a note by keyboard destroys the focused button, and focus is not moved anywhere
evidence: The click handler (app.js:161-166) calls selectNote or deleteNote, and both end in renderList(), which replaces every list button. The focused Open or Delete button is removed from the DOM, and no code calls focus() on a replacement, on the editor or on the list. Only createNote moves focus (app.js:109). Traced.
failing_case: A keyboard user tabs to a note's Open button and presses Enter. The button is replaced and focus falls to <body>. The editor does not receive focus, so they cannot start typing. A screen reader loses its place and announces nothing about the opened note. After Delete plus confirm, the same happens and the user has to find their position in the list again (WCAG 2.4.3, 3.2.2 intent).
remediation: After selectNote from a click, focus the title field (or the re-rendered `[aria-current]` button). After a delete, focus the next row's Open button or the New note button. Or update list items in place by id instead of replacing them all.

title: The open note disappears from the list when it does not match the active search
evidence: renderList filters every note by title, including the current one. createNote (app.js:103-111) creates 'Untitled' and selects it without clearing the search. The editor shows the note while the list does not. Traced.
failing_case: Search 'meeting', press New note. The editor opens an 'Untitled' note, and the list shows 'No notes match "meeting"'. Or with search 'foo' active, rename the open note to 'bar': after the 500 ms flush it vanishes from the list while still open. No row has aria-current, and Delete is not reachable for it.
remediation: Clear the search in createNote, and always include the current note in `shown` (or mark it as outside the filter).

title: A new note created while a search is active is selected but missing from the visible list
evidence: createNote does not clear the search box. renderList filters by the query, and the new note is titled 'Untitled'. Traced.
failing_case: The user searches 'budget', then presses New note. The editor shows the new note and focuses the title, but the list says 'No notes match "budget".' or omits the new note. There is no aria-current item and no sign that the note was created.
remediation: Clear els.search.value (and call searchShared('')) in createNote before selectNote.

title: The load-problem message lives in the shared save-status line and is wiped by the first edit or click, with no way to recover the backup in the UI
evidence: The message uses the same #status element as saves. onEdit sets 'Saving…' (app.js:56) and commit sets 'Saved' (app.js:34), so the message disappears on the first keystroke or New note click. The backup is reachable only through devtools localStorage. Traced.
failing_case: Stored data had two unreadable notes. The page shows 'Skipped 2... kept under notes-backup'. The user clicks New note: the status reads 'Saved' and the notice is gone. The 'notes' key is now rewritten without those notes, and a non-developer has no way to get them from 'notes-backup'.
remediation: Show the problem in its own persistent, dismissible banner with a 'Download backup' action, separate from the save status.
